inlines.v: ADOSCULA'TION, noun [Latin ad and osculatio, a kissing, from osculum, a kiss, or mouth.] The impregnation of plants by the falling of the farina on the pistils. Adosculation is also defined to be the inserting of one part of a plant into another.
